postAsShort.displayName: Treat videos as short-form vertical videos
postAsShort.description: We will treat the videos imported as short-form vertical videos (Reels, Shorts, Tiktoks etc...).

aiMetadata.description: Publishes a social media post through Nuelink to the connected social channels, with a required caption and optional media URL, title (for Reels/videos/Pinterest), alt text, and flags to share Instagram Reels to the feed or treat videos as short-form vertical content. Choose this to publish or schedule content via Nuelink. Not idempotent: each call creates a new post.
